title: Nexo (NEXO) Listing Postponed
text: Fellow Binancians, The trading start time for Nexo (NEXO), originally set at 2022-04-29 10:00 (UTC), will be postponed to  2022-04-29 14:00 (UTC). For more information:  Binance Will List MobileCoin (MOB) and Nexo (NEXO) Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously.
